_meta.purpose: The gate/friction config surface named in ROADMAP's per-project manager-optimizer bullet (Phase 48 implements). Human-facing gate and friction adjustments land HERE — never in CLAUDE_MANAGER.md, which is the AI-facing directive surface. Per-project: each install tunes its own copy.
_meta.consumers: token-cost-monitor (first consumer — reads the cost block below); manager-optimizer (second consumer, Phase 53 — reads the optimizer block below, and DRAFTS adjustments to existing keys and the operation_tiers/friction slots for the user's approval; approval-gated autonomy holds).
_meta.routing_rule: AI-directive changes -> CLAUDE_MANAGER.md. Human/gate adjustments -> this file. Nothing in Phase 48 writes to this file programmatically; edits are human edits.

schema.cost: Live (Phase 48). enabled: master switch for ambient cost surfaces. assumed_model: pricing row from telemetry/model-pricing.json used for dollar estimates (telemetry does not record the model, so estimates must state their assumption). warn_usd_per_session: compared against the PER-SITTING delta (latest rollup minus the prior checkpoint in the same lineage; delta == total for un-resumed sessions) — not the cumulative lineage figure (Phase 66). warn_usd_per_7d: trailing-7-day per-lineage window delta. Both estimates at assumed_model rates.
schema.operation_tiers: Live (Phase 85). Descriptive classification of the five operation classes per ROADMAP Appendix — reads / scratch_writes / repo_writes / destructive_external / credentials_financial_pii. Classification only; lanes live in the friction block. tier_5 appears HERE (as a class that exists) but never in friction (as a knob that could move).
schema.friction: Live (Phase 85). Maps tiers 1-4 to lanes from the closed enum flow_with_receipt | surface_choice | hard_stop, plus tier_3_class_overrides: named tier-3 operation classes an install may move to a different lane (the optimizer's draft target; user-approved edits only). tier_4's lane governs the operation class; its destructive-pattern floor is hard_stop, non-configurable, enforced by the PreToolUse hooks via the shared pattern libs. tier_5 has NO friction key — structurally non-configurable, permanently hard_stop. REJECTED SHAPE: no lane may bypass the PreToolUse safety hooks; the hooks are the floor, the lanes sit above them.
schema.optimizer: Live (Phase 53). enabled: master switch for the SessionStart nudge line. run_every_sessions: sessions-since-last-run threshold at which the nudge fires. nudge_cooldown_sessions: minimum sessions between nudge lines. The counter itself lives in the gitignored runtime file telemetry/optimizer-state.json.
schema.audits: Live (Phase 74). Registry of dispatch-class audits on session-count cadences (sessions, never calendar time). Per entry: enabled (master switch) + sessions_between_dispatches (the cadence). Counters live in gitignored telemetry/audit-state.json, incremented every SessionEnd for every registered audit; the manager's dispatch flow resets an entry at dispatch. Extensible: future dispatch-class audits register here. Registrants: artifact_fit_analyzer (Phase 74, ships in template) + roadmap_auditor (Phase 75, dogfood-only — skeleton-level claim integrity, never ships in template) + plugin_discovery (Phase 76, ships in template — plugin-ecosystem inventory into the draft recommendation manifest).

tier_1.examples: file views, grep, ls, public web fetch

tier_4.examples: destructive bash/git, external system calls, file ops outside the project

tier_4.destructive_pattern_floor: hard_stop (non-configurable; enforced by PreToolUse hooks via .claude/lib/destructive-bash-patterns.sh + destructive-powershell-patterns.sh)
